reason: Need the PO receiving procedure, vendor identification for Globex, and system URLs from company overview

objective: Mark the latest PO from Globex as received.
steps: Resolve the vendor name "Globex" to its canonical name using lookup_vendor, then find the latest purchase order document for that vendor with find_latest_document(kind="po", vendor=<canonical name>), read the source PDF file with read_file to extract and confirm the PO number.
Open the ERP PO list page at http://127.0.0.1:5001/pos, locate the PO entry matching the confirmed PO number from step 1, and click it to open the PO detail page.

On the PO detail page, submit the receive record using submit_record with record_type="po_receive", vendor="Globex Inc", and po_number set to the confirmed PO number, then capture a screenshot of the result.
assumptions: The vendor "Globex" maps unambiguously to "Globex Inc".
The latest PO is uniquely identified by its date inside the document.
The PO is not already marked as received in the ERP.
